mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "search" browses or keyword-searches Singapore court judgments, with automatic pagination. "judgment" fetches the full text of specific judgment ID(s) directly.

searchPhrase.title: Search phrase
searchPhrase.description: "search" mode -- free-text search across the judgment archive, e.g. "negligence", "minority oppression", a party name, or a citation. Leave empty to browse everything newest-first.

year.title: Year of decision
year.description: "search" mode -- restrict to a single year of decision (e.g. "2025"), or "All" for the entire archive, which reaches back to 1965.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: "search" mode -- order results by decision date or by case title.

sortAscending.title: Sort ascending
sortAscending.description: "search" mode -- when false (default), newest/last judgments come first. Set true to start from the oldest.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: "search" mode -- maximum number of judgments to return. Results are paginated 10 per page and followed automatically until this cap or the end of the result set.

fetchFullText.title: Include full judgment text
fetchFullText.description: "search" mode -- when true, every result is additionally fetched for the complete written judgment (court, presiding judge, hearing dates and the full opinion text, often 100,000+ characters). When false (default), only the summary row is returned, which is far faster and cheaper for large result sets.

judgmentIds.title: Judgment IDs
judgmentIds.description: "judgment" mode -- judgment IDs to fetch full text for, in the portal's own format "<year>_<court>_<number>", e.g. "2026_SGHC_175" or "2026_SGHCA_22". These appear as the "judgmentId" field of any search result.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many judgment pages to fetch in parallel ("search" mode's full-text enrichment, or "judgment" mode's ID list).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
